item.title: Sky Bet League Two: Weekend round-up
item.description: Grimsby Town held Bromley to a 1–1 draw at Blundell Park, extending the Sky Bet League Two leaders’ run to five draws in their last six games. Bromley took the lead in the 28th minute when Nicke Kabamba capitalised on a defensive mix-up to score into an empty net. The hosts responded quickly, with Charles Vernam converting a penalty three minutes later after Jude Arthurs handled in the box. item.title: Sky Bet League One: Weekend round-up
item.description: Lincoln City moved to the summit of Sky Bet League One with a 2-0 win over Cardiff City in top of the table chash at the Cardiff City Stadium. Rob Street opened the scoring before Dom Jefferies doubled the lead late on to stretch their unbeaten league run to 18 matches. It was an inspired performance in the Imps goal from George Wickens as he kept a clean sheet to deny Cardiff any chance of a comeback and handing Lincoln top spot. item.title: Port Vale stun Sunderland to reach FA Cup Quarter-Finals
item.description: Port Vale produced one of the shocks of the season as the Sky Bet League One side defeated Premier League Sunderland to book their place in the Emirates FA Cup Quarter-Finals. It marks the first time since 1954 that Vale have reached the last eight, despite currently sitting bottom of the third tier. item.title: Maycock strike earns AFC Wimbledon vital home victory
item.description: AFC Wimbledon moved further clear of the Sky Bet League One relegation battle as Callum Maycock’s early goal sealed a narrow victory over Northampton Town at Plough Lane. Maycock struck after just 10 minutes, finishing confidently following a clever backheel from Marcus Browne to cap a dominant first-half display from the hosts. item.title: Sky Bet Championship: Weekend round-up
item.description: Haji Wright continued his prolific form with his sixth goal in five games as top of the table Coventry City beat Bristol City 2-0 at Ashton Gate to maintain their promotion push. item.title: Bristol Rovers launch The John Green Campaign to raise prostate cancer awareness
item.description: Bristol Rovers Football Club, Bristol Rovers Community Trust, North Bristol NHS Trust – part of Bristol NHS Group – and the Somerset, Wiltshire, Avon and Gloucestershire (SWAG) Cancer Alliance have jointly announced the launch of The John Green Campaign. The initiative aims to raise awareness of prostate cancer risk, increase knowledge among male supporters and their families, encourage early detection and connect the community with local health resources.
